en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who prevents a Right of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would spend double the like of it in falsehood (the wrong way)’.
en.sarwar: 21. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one who refuses to pay the right of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, spends double as much for falsehood.”
